The following tests currently fail and should pass after your change:
tests/dialects/test_bigquery.py::TestBigQuery::test_set_operations

args.new:
# FULL and LEFT can be set-operation modifiers (for example, BigQuery's
        # `SELECT ... FULL UNION ALL SELECT ...`). Don't consume them as implicit
        # aliases when they are immediately followed by a set operator.
        if self._curr.token_type in (TokenType.FULL, TokenType.LEFT):
            start = self._index
            self._advance()
            if self._curr.token_type == TokenType.OUTER:
                self._advance()
            is_set_operation = self._curr.token_type in self.SET_OPERATIONS
            self._retreat(start)
            if is_set_operation:
                return this

        any_token = self._match(TokenType.ALIAS)
        comments = self._prev_comments
